study_identification.title: Multimodal normative modeling in Alzheimer's Disease with introspective variational autoencoders

study_characteristics.study_objective: Develop and evaluate a multimodal introspective VAE (mmSIVAE) with MOPOE aggregation to improve normative modeling by better capturing healthy control distributions and aggregating information across T1 MRI and amyloid PET for AD deviation detection and interpretability.

clinical_application_and_analysis.association_analysis: Linear regression (adjusted for age and sex) relating DSI_all and ATN summary metrics to composite cognitive scores (memory, executive functioning, language); reported betas, p-values, and correlations.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_brief: mmSIVAE improved reconstruction of healthy controls and outperformed baselines in outlier detection; multimodal latent deviations yielded higher likelihood ratios; deviations mapped to AD-relevant regions and associated with cognitive impairment.
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_findings_detailed: Across ROIs, mmSIVAE showed lowest reconstruction errors vs baselines (Figure 3). For outlier detection, latent Mahalanobis-based likelihood ratios were highest for mmSIVAE with MOPOE (e.g., d=15: 10.2). Hamming distance analyses indicated within-stage heterogeneity of abnormality patterns. DSI_all exhibited strong negative associations with cognitive composites in both ADNI-ADS and ADRC-ADS cohorts (Table 2).
clinical_application_and_analysis.key_limitations: Site/scanner harmonization not reported; QC descriptions incomplete and mainly for ADRC; ADNI preprocessing details referred to an appendix not available here; analyses performed at ROI level which may limit spatial specificity.
clinical_application_and_analysis.application_notes: Conditioning on age/sex helps mitigate nuisance effects; multimodal aggregation (MOPOE) leverages complementary MRI and amyloid PET information; latent and feature deviations provide complementary markers for OOD detection and regional interpretability.

general_notes.general_notes: ADRC supplementary methods include FreeSurfer v5.3 MRI pipeline and PUP PET processing with smoothing and motion correction; tau PET described for ADRC but primary normative model uses T1 volumes and amyloid AV45 SUVR. Some ADNI acquisition/preprocessing details are referenced to Appendix B (not available in provided materials).
